process_area.title: COD Cash Collection, Custody & Driver/3PL Reconciliation

value_stream.name: Cash-on-Delivery (COD) Operations, Driver Cash Handling & Reconciliation

fields.Frequency: Per COD order (~4,000–8,000/month, a ~23–47% COD share of the ~17,200 delivery orders)
fields.Volume: Each COD order with an amount-due for collection

workflows.name: COD Order Handoff, Delivery Note & Amount-Due Computation

Automation Opportunity: - Auto amount-due computation & lock; COD-flag handoff to delivery app; handoff-completeness dashboard
Controls: - CTL-657 (ensure controlled execution — COD Cash Collection, Custody & Driver/3PL Reconciliation (PA-142.2).)
- CTL-657: amount-due system-computed & locked; risk-tier auth applied (W4266); handoff completeness monitored
Cross-references: - links to VS-10 (order), VS-01.2/W4267 (fee), VS-06.3 (delivery app), VS-13 (loyalty), W4266 (auth), W4274 (collection)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Wrong-amount risk**: Driver collects wrong amount → dispute/loss; mitigated by system-computed locked amount-due on the note
- **Handoff-gap risk**: COD order released without amount/driver assignment; mitigated by handoff-completeness monitoring
System Touchpoints: - Order/ecommerce (VS-10); pricing/fee (VS-01.2/W4267); delivery app (VS-06.3); risk auth (W4266); loyalty (VS-13)
Time Estimate: - Automated per order; monitoring part of daily ops

steps.activity: Order Mgmt/Payment Ops compute the exact COD amount-due (item total + COD fee W4267 − pre-paid deposit − loyalty redemption + delivery fee), apply risk-tier auth (W4266), and freeze the amount on the delivery note
Order Mgmt/Last-Mile generate the COD delivery note (amount-due, item list, customer ID, payment-instruction) and hand off to the driver/3PL via the delivery app (VS-06.3), flagging COD vs pre-paid
Payment Ops monitor COD handoff completeness (every COD order has a locked amount-due + assigned driver), and flag undelivered/COD-released exceptions

fields.Volume: Each COD cash collection at the doorstep

workflows.name: Doorstep Cash Collection, Receipting & POD Capture

Automation Opportunity: - Mobile POD with amount capture & customer signature; digital receipt (BIR-compliant); counterfeit-detection guidance; cash-status auto-update
Controls: - CTL-657 (ensure controlled execution — COD Cash Collection, Custody & Driver/3PL Reconciliation (PA-142.2).)
- CTL-657: amount verified vs locked amount-due (W4273); POD/receipt captured (W4270/W4271); exceptions handled (W4276)
Cross-references: - links to VS-06.3 (delivery/POD), VS-56 (3PL), VS-79/W4271 (receipt), VS-125 (fraud), W4270 (controls), W4273 (amount-due), W4276 (short-pay), W4277 (reconciliation)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Counterfeit/short-pay risk**: Fake bill or underpayment; mitigated by denomination check + short-pay handling (W4276)
- **No-evidence risk**: Cash collected without POD → unrecoverable; mitigated by mandatory digital POD/receipt
System Touchpoints: - Delivery app/POD (VS-06.3); order cash-status (W4272); receipting (VS-79/W4271); fraud/exception (VS-125)

steps.activity: Driver deliver the order, state the exact amount-due (per W4273), collect cash, verify denomination/authenticity (counterfeit check), and confirm exact amount or process short-pay (W4276)

Driver capture proof of delivery + cash collected (digital POD with amount, customer signature/photo receipt per W4270 standard), issue customer receipt (BIR-compliant per W4271), and update order cash-status in the app
Payment Ops/Fraud monitor collection exceptions (no-cash, short-pay, counterfeit flag), trigger refusal/return handling (W4276), and feed data to reconciliation (W4277)

fields.Volume: Daily cash custody & remittance across the driver/3PL network

workflows.name: Driver/3PL Daily Cash Custody, Remittance & Deposit

Automation Opportunity: - POD→remittance auto-match; bank-deposit feed reconciliation; unremitted-cash aging dashboard & alerts
Controls: - CTL-657 (ensure controlled execution — COD Cash Collection, Custody & Driver/3PL Reconciliation (PA-142.2).)
- CTL-657: tamper-evident custody; no-cash-overnight; remittance SLA; deposit verified (VS-18); aging tracked
Cross-references: - links to VS-06.3 (delivery), VS-18 (treasury/bank), VS-81 (CIT), W4270 (controls), W4269 (float), W4278 (3PL file), W4279 (GL posting)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Holding/robbery risk**: Cash held overnight/en route; mitigated by no-cash-overnight, tamper-evident custody, CIT (VS-81)
- **Float risk**: Slow remittance ties up working capital; mitigated by remittance SLA & aging tracking (W4269)
System Touchpoints: - Delivery app/POD (VS-06.3); treasury/bank (VS-18); CIT (VS-81); 3PL cash file (W4278); GL (VS-17.1)

steps.activity: Driver/3PL secure the day's collected cash (tamper-evident bag per W4270, no-cash-overnight rule), reconcile to POD records, and remit to the 3PL depot/branch or BuildRight cash office within the SLA
3PL depot/cash office verify & accept the remittance (count, match to POD list, sign handoff), deposit to bank (VS-18) or arrange CIT pickup (VS-81), and transmit the cash file to BuildRight (W4278)
Treasury/Payment Ops confirm bank deposit (deposit slip/bank feed VS-18), track unremitted-cash aging (W4269 float), and escalate overdue remittance per SLA

fields.Frequency: Daily (~COD refusal rate 5–15% in PH ecommerce)
fields.Participants: Driver/3PL, Customer Support (VS-13), Returns (VS-32), Fraud (VS-125), Inventory (VS-05)
fields.Trigger: Customer refuses delivery, short-pays, or is unreachable

workflows.name: COD Refusal, Short-Pay & Failed-Delivery Cash Handling

Automation Opportunity: - Refusal-reason capture & pattern analytics; auto-eligibility tuning; RTV/inventory auto-update
Controls: - CTL-657 (ensure controlled execution — COD Cash Collection, Custody & Driver/3PL Reconciliation (PA-142.2).)
- CTL-657: refusal/short-pay evidenced; partial cash posted; stock returned (VS-32); repeat-refusal flagged (VS-125)
Cross-references: - links to VS-06.3 (delivery), VS-32 (returns/RTV), VS-05 (inventory), VS-125 (fraud), VS-13 (support), W4266 (eligibility), W4274 (collection), W4287 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Abuse risk**: Serial refusers tie up capacity/inventory; mitigated by refusal tracking & eligibility tuning (W4266)
- **Recovery risk**: Partial cash/stock not reconciled; mitigated by partial-payment posting & RTV (VS-32)
System Touchpoints: - Delivery app (VS-06.3); returns/RTV (VS-32); inventory (VS-05); fraud (VS-125); customer support (VS-13); order (VS-10)

steps.activity: Driver/3PL record refusal/short-pay/failed-delivery with reason & evidence (photo/attempt log), collect any partial cash due (with POD per W4274), and return the goods per the RTV process (VS-32)
Payment Ops/Returns process the order outcome (cancel/return to stock VS-32/VS-05, partial-payment posting, restocking fee per policy), and flag repeat-refusal customers to fraud (VS-125)
Customer Support (VS-13) follow up on failed deliveries (reschedule, address correction), and Fraud/Payment Ops analyze refusal patterns (W4287) to tune eligibility (W4266)

fields.Participants: Finance (VS-17.4), GL (VS-17.1), AR/Cash App (VS-16), Last-Mile (VS-06.3), Fraud (VS-125)
fields.Trigger: Daily close (VS-17.1); receipt of remittance/3PL file
fields.Volume: All COD orders dispatched/collected that day (~thousands/day)

workflows.name: Daily COD Cash-vs-Order Reconciliation & Exception Resolution

Automation Opportunity: - Auto cash-to-order matching (POD+remittance+deposit vs amount-due); exception auto-flag; auto-aging
Controls: - CTL-657: daily order-level reconciliation; exceptions resolved within SLA; unreconciled provisioned (W4269); SoD (W4270)
Cross-references: - links to VS-17.1 (GL), VS-16 (AR/cash app), VS-06.3 (POD), VS-18 (bank), VS-125 (fraud), W4269 (provision), W4273 (amount-due), W4279 (posting), W4287 (reporting)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unreconciled-cash risk**: Cash without an order match → leakage/write-off; mitigated by daily order-level reconciliation & aging
- **Manual-effort risk**: High-volume manual matching; mitigated by automation (W4272 architecture)
System Touchpoints: - GL/reconciliation (VS-17.1); AR/cash app (VS-16); delivery/POD (VS-06.3); bank (VS-18); fraud (VS-125); analytics (VS-28)
Time Estimate: - ~0.5–1 FTE daily at scale; continuous exception handling

steps.activity: Finance/Cash App reconcile cash collected (POD W4274 + 3PL remittance W4275 + bank deposit W4279) against each COD order's amount-due (W4273), at order level, daily
Finance/Payment Ops investigate exceptions (over/short, unmatched cash, missing POD, duplicate), route to driver/3PL/Fraud, and resolve within SLA
Finance post the reconciled cash to the GL/revenue (W4279), provision unremitted/unreconciled balances (W4269), and report reconciliation health (W4287)

workflows.name: 3PL COD Cash File Ingest, Match & Discrepancy Handling

Automation Opportunity: - Auto file ingest & validation; auto-match with discrepancy flag; holdback auto-deduction
Controls: - CTL-657 (ensure controlled execution — COD Cash Collection, Custody & Driver/3PL Reconciliation (PA-142.2).)
- CTL-657: 3PL file validated & matched; discrepancies raised/SLA-tracked; holdback applied (W4268)
Cross-references: - links to VS-56/VS-06.3 (3PL/delivery), VS-17.1 (GL), VS-67 (scorecard), VS-27 (IT), W4268 (contract/holdback), W4272 (architecture), W4277 (reconciliation)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Data-quality risk**: Incomplete/late 3PL file → reconciliation gap; mitigated by file-validation & SLA
- **Discrepancy risk**: 3PL-reported cash ≠ order cash; mitigated by matching + contract holdback (W4268)
System Touchpoints: - 3PL integration (VS-56/W4272); delivery/POD (VS-06.3); finance/GL (VS-17.1); vendor scorecard (VS-67); IT (VS-27)

steps.activity: IT/Payment Ops ingest the 3PL daily cash file (per-order collected amount, remittance, deposit reference) via the agreed format/exchange (W4272), validate structure & completeness
Payment Ops/Finance match the 3PL file to BuildRight POD/orders (W4273/W4274), flag discrepancies (missing orders, amount mismatch, missing deposit), and raise to the 3PL per contract (W4268)
Payment Ops track discrepancy resolution/SLA, apply contract holdback/penalty (W4268), and feed 3PL performance to scorecard (VS-67) and reconciliation (W4277)

fields.Participants: Treasury (VS-18), GL (VS-17.1), Cash App (VS-16), Bank, Payment Ops
fields.Volume: Bank deposits of COD cash across accounts

workflows.name: COD Bank Deposit Verification & GL Cash Posting

Automation Opportunity: - Bank-feed auto-reconciliation; GL auto-posting with revenue/VAT coding; bank-rec automation
Controls: - CTL-657: deposit verified vs remittance; revenue recognized at delivery (W4271); VAT-coded (VS-79); bank rec closed
Cross-references: - links to VS-18 (treasury/bank), VS-17.1 (GL/revenue), VS-16 (AR), VS-79 (tax), W4271 (recognition), W4275/W4278 (remittance/file), W4277 (reconciliation)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Deposit-gap risk**: Cash remitted but not deposited → theft/loss; mitigated by deposit-vs-remittance verification
- **Recognition-error risk**: Revenue mis-timed/mis-coded; mitigated by recognize-at-delivery rule & VAT coding (VS-79)
System Touchpoints: - Treasury/bank (VS-18); GL/revenue (VS-17.1); AR/cash app (VS-16); tax/BIR (VS-79); analytics (VS-28)

steps.activity: Treasury/GL verify the bank deposit (deposit slip vs bank statement/feed VS-18) against the remittance/cash file (W4275/W4278), confirming cash reached the bank
GL post the reconciled COD cash to revenue/AR (recognize at delivery per W4271), clear the COD receivable/float, and post COD fee/handling revenue (W4267)
Finance reconcile GL cash to bank (VS-17.1 bank rec), investigate variances, and ensure VAT/tax coding per VS-79

fields.Owner: Security (VS-23) / Payment Ops / Insurance (VS-26) / Loss Prevention
fields.Participants: Security (VS-23), Insurance (VS-26), Legal (VS-100), Fraud (VS-125), Treasury (VS-18), Police
fields.Volume: Security incidents across the COD cash chain

workflows.name: COD Physical Cash Security, Robbery/Loss Response & Recovery

Automation Opportunity: - In-app SOS/panic; incident→security/insurance workflow; loss-provision auto-suggestion
Controls: - CTL-657 (ensure controlled execution — COD Cash Collection, Custody & Driver/3PL Reconciliation (PA-142.2).)
- CTL-657: cash-security SOP followed; custody controls (W4270); claim/recovery pursued (VS-26); loss provisioned (W4269)
Cross-references: - links to VS-23 (security), VS-26 (insurance), VS-125 (fraud), VS-100 (legal), VS-81 (CIT), VS-18/VS-17.1 (GL), W4268 (3PL recovery), W4269 (loss), W4270 (controls)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Loss risk**: Robbery/theft of COD cash; mitigated by custody controls (W4270), CIT (VS-81), insurance (VS-26)
- **Recovery risk**: Unrecovered loss distorts earnings; mitigated by claims/recovery & provisioning (W4269)

steps.activity: Driver/3PL/Security execute the incident response (safety first, secure scene, notify Security/Payment Ops/police), per the cash-security SOP (W4270)

steps.a: Head of Internal Audit & Risk / COO
steps.activity: Security/Fraud investigate (root cause, custody breakdown, internal vs external), document, and log to the loss/security system (VS-23/VS-125)

steps.a: CFO / Head of Internal Audit & Risk
steps.activity: Insurance/Legal file the claim (VS-26), pursue recovery (3PL contract W4268, fidelity bond, police/legal VS-100), provision/write off unrecovered loss (W4269), and apply corrective action
